{{recipe}}

'''Soft-boiled eggs''' are a variety of whole boiled egg where the white is solid and the yolk is runny. They take about 7 minutes to prepare and are often served with buttered toast, perfect for dipping into the runny yolk.

==Ingredients==
*2–3 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], depending on appetite
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] (optional)

==Equipment==
*Small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]
*[[Cookbook:Cooktop|Stovetop]]
*A [[Cookbook:Slotted Spoon|slotted spoon]]
*A sharp pin or tack (optional)

==Procedure==

There are several popular ways to make soft-boiled eggs, and it is up to the cook to decide which method works best for them. Some of the most common ones follow.

=== Method 1 ===
This method boils the eggs continuously in the water.

# Bring a saucepan of water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Gently add the eggs, and boil for 4–6 minutes (4 minutes for runny yolk, 5 minutes for soft yolk).
# Remove the eggs from the water.

===Method 2===
This method boils the egg for a brief period of time before letting it sit in hot water.
#Bring water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a saucepan. 
#Gently add the eggs, and boil for 1 minute.
#Remove the saucepan from the heat, and allow eggs to stand in the hot water for 5 minutes.
# Remove the eggs from the water.

=== Method 3 ===
This method does not boil the eggs at all, instead letting them sit in hot water for a longer period of time.
# Bring water to a rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a saucepan.
#Gently add the eggs, then immediately remove the pan from heat and cover it.
#Let the eggs sit for 8 minutes, then remove them.

=== Method 4 ===
This method uses steam to cook the whites firmly while still maintaining a perfectly cooked, runny yolk. It produces consistent results every time.
#Bring about 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] of water to a rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a saucepan. You want just enough water to create steam but not evaporate completely.
#Gently add the eggs, then cover with a lid.
#Let boil/[[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] for 6–6½ minutes, depending on how runny you want the yolks.
#Immediately remove pot from heat, and drain the hot water.

== Serving ==
[[File:Egg (Explored 2015-11-02) - Flickr - Maria Eklind.jpg|thumb|Serve soft-boiled eggs in an egg cup, so that the interior does not leak out.]]
#To serve, place eggs in an egg cup, shot glass, or anything that will allow the egg to stay upright.
#Using a small spoon, repeatedly tap the top of the eggs until an area the size of the spoon is cracked
#Dig the spoon across the bottom of the cracked area to remove the top.
#Use the spoon to eat from the egg shell, and/or cut toast into strips and dip into the egg.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Adding a bit of salt to the cooking water can help to quickly set the whites if the egg leaks during cooking.
* Running the cooked eggs under cold water will help stop the cooking process.
* Some people use a pin to poke a small hole on the larger end of the egg before boiling it. It is believed that this helps give the egg a smooth, round bottom, and some say the pinhole makes it easier to peel.
* Soft-boiled eggs can be carefully peeled as an alternative serving method.

== External links ==

* https://www.exploratorium.edu/cooking/eggs/explore-text.html
